title: GPIR Content Change Event
description: A machine-readable record of a content object being created, updated, corrected, or archived. See docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md §10. Events are appended to assets/data/content/events/change-events.jsonl -- this schema describes one line of that file.

eventId.description: Stable, unique id for this event -- evt-{contentId}-{sequence}.

contentId.description: The `id` of the content object this event is about (assets/data/content/**).

topics.description: Derived from the content object's own topic/subtopic fields and any Research->Topic relationships -- not a separately hand-maintained list.

entities.description: Ids of related `entity` content objects, derived from the content object's own `relationships` array (any edge whose targetType is "entity") -- not a separately hand-maintained list.

contentVersion.description: The content MODEL schema version this event was generated under (see content-object.schema.json's $comment) -- e.g. "1.0.0". Distinct from previousVersion/newVersion, which are the individual content object's own version number.

previousVersion.description: The content object's own `version` before this event. Null for a CREATED event -- there is no prior version.

newVersion.description: The content object's own `version` after this event.

source.description: What authorized/caused this change -- an editorial process description, ideally including a git commit reference for traceability. Never an AI-generated justification (no AI analysis exists yet).

significanceStatus.description: Honest placeholder, not a computed score -- "do not build AI analysis yet" means nothing currently calculates this. UNASSESSED unless a human explicitly sets it at generation time. Exists so a future intelligence-processing consumer has a field to read once one does.
